mapper.sql: ASSESSMENT_ID AS assessmentId, REQUEST_ID AS requestId, USER_ID AS userId, WORKER_TYPE_CODE AS workerTypeCode, AGE_BAND_CODE AS ageBandCode, INPUT_BASE_MONTH AS inputBaseMonth, MODEL_VERSION AS modelVersion, FEATURE_SET_VERSION AS featureSetVersion, CUTOFF_VERSION AS cutoffVersion, GRADE_STATUS_CODE AS gradeStatusCode, NOT_SCORABLE_REASON_CODE AS notScorableReasonCode, TRAD_SCORABLE_YN AS tradScorableYn, TRAD_SCORE AS tradScore, TRAD_GRADE_BAND_CODE AS tradGradeBandCode, TRAD_DEFAULT_PROB AS tradDefaultProb, ALT_SCORABLE_YN AS altScorableYn, ALT_SCORE AS altScore, ALT_GRADE_BAND_CODE AS altGradeBandCode, ALT_DEFAULT_PROB AS altDefaultProb, SHAP_BASE_SCORE AS shapBaseScore, AI_SUMMARY AS aiSummary, ASSESSED_AT AS assessedAt
mapper.select: SELECT MODEL_VERSION FROM MODEL_REGISTRY WHERE STATUS_CODE = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY ACTIVATED_AT DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT SETTING_VALUE FROM APP_SETTING WHERE SETTING_KEY = #{settingKey}
SELECT REQUIRED_INCOME_MONTHS FROM DIM_WORKER_TYPE WHERE WORKER_TYPE_CODE = #{workerTypeCode}

SELECT USER_ID AS userId, BILL_MONTH AS billMonth, BILLED_AMT AS billedAmt, DUE_DATE AS dueDate, PAID_DATE AS paidDate, PAYMENT_STATUS_CODE AS paymentStatusCode FROM USER_TELECOM_PAYMENT WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND SOURCE_CODE = 'IMPORTED' ORDER BY BILL_MONTH

SELECT USER_ID AS userId, BILL_MONTH AS billMonth, BILLED_AMT AS billedAmt, DUE_DATE AS dueDate, PAID_DATE AS paidDate, PAYMENT_STATUS_CODE AS paymentStatusCode FROM USER_UTILITY_PAYMENT WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND SOURCE_CODE = 'IMPORTED' ORDER BY BILL_MONTH

SELECT USER_ID AS userId, BASE_MONTH AS baseMonth, OBSERVATION_STATUS_CODE AS observationStatusCode, PAYMENT_COUNT AS paymentCount, PAYMENT_AMT AS paymentAmt, ACTIVE_DAYS AS activeDays FROM USER_EASYPAY_USAGE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND SOURCE_CODE = 'IMPORTED' ORDER BY BASE_MONTH

SELECT USER_ID AS userId, INSURANCE_TYPE_CODE AS insuranceTypeCode, BASE_MONTH AS baseMonth, COVERAGE_STATUS_CODE AS coverageStatusCode, PAYER_TYPE_CODE AS payerTypeCode, INDIVIDUAL_AMT AS individualAmt, PAID_AMT AS paidAmt, PAYMENT_STATUS_CODE AS paymentStatusCode FROM USER_SOCIAL_INSURANCE_PAYMENT WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND SOURCE_CODE = 'IMPORTED' ORDER BY INSURANCE_TYPE_CODE, BASE_MONTH
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ASSESSMENT ( REQUEST_ID, USER_ID, DATASET_CODE, WORKER_TYPE_CODE, AGE_BAND_CODE, INPUT_BASE_MONTH, MODEL_VERSION, FEATURE_SET_VERSION, CUTOFF_VERSION, GRADE_STATUS_CODE, NOT_SCORABLE_REASON_CODE, TRAD_SCORABLE_YN, TRAD_SCORE, TRAD_GRADE_BAND_CODE, TRAD_DEFAULT_PROB, ALT_SCORABLE_YN, ALT_SCORE, ALT_GRADE_BAND_CODE, ALT_DEFAULT_PROB, SHAP_BASE_SCORE, FEATURE_SNAPSHOT, ASSESSED_AT, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{requestId}, #{userId}, 'SERVICE', #{workerTypeCode}, #{ageBandCode}, #{inputBaseMonth}, #{modelVersion}, #{featureSetVersion, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cutoffVersion, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{gradeStatusCode}, #{notScorableReasonCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tradScorableYn}, #{tradScore, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{tradGradeBandCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tradDefaultProb, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{altScorableYn}, #{altScore, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{altGradeBandCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{altDefaultProb, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{shapBaseScore, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{featureSnapshot, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{assessedAt}, #{assessedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ASSESSMENT WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND DATASET_CODE = 'SERVICE' ORDER BY ASSESSED_AT DESC, ASSESSMENT_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT FROM ASSESSMENT WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND DATASET_CODE = 'SERVICE'
SELECT FROM ASSESSMENT WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND DATASET_CODE = 'SERVICE' ORDER BY ASSESSED_AT DESC, ASSESSMENT_ID DESC

SELECT f.ASSESSMENT_ID AS assessmentId, f.FEATURE_SET_VERSION AS featureSetVersion, f.FEATURE_RANK AS featureRank, f.FEATURE_CODE AS featureCode, f.FEATURE_VALUE AS featureValue, f.SHAP_VALUE AS shapValue, f.SHAP_SCORE AS shapScore, d.FEATURE_NAME AS featureName, d.UNIT_NAME AS unitName, d.ALTERNATIVE_YN AS alternativeYn, d.SIMULATABLE_YN AS simulatableYn FROM ASSESSMENT_FACTOR f JOIN DIM_FEATURE d ON d.FEATURE_SET_VERSION = f.FEATURE_SET_VERSION AND d.FEATURE_CODE = f.FEATURE_CODE WHERE f.ASSESSMENT_ID = #{assessmentId} ORDER BY f.FEATURE_RANK
SELECT GRADE_BAND_CODE AS gradeBandCode, MIN_SCORE AS minScore, MAX_SCORE AS maxScore FROM SCORE_GRADE_BAND WHERE CUTOFF_VERSION = #{cutoffVersion} ORDER BY DISPLAY_ORDER

SELECT FEATURE_CODE AS featureCode, FEATURE_NAME AS featureName, ALTERNATIVE_YN AS alternativeYn FROM DIM_FEATURE WHERE FEATURE_SET_VERSION = NVL(#{featureSetVersion, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, (SELECT FEATURE_SET_VERSION FROM MODEL_REGISTRY WHERE MODEL_VERSION = #{modelVersion, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) ORDER BY DISPLAY_ORDER, FEATURE_CODE
